name: Elbowside Strike
description: Hold the side handle and push the long arm straight out like a stiff punch into the ribs.

name: Tonfacowl
description: Lay the long arm flat along the forearm and raise it before the face against a swinging blow.

name: Low Forearm
description: Snap the short end forward past the fist to knock the knuckles or wrist of a gripping hand.

name: Tonfahusk
description: Turn the forearm rail outward to push a thrown strike wide of the body.

name: Light Forearmside
description: Slide the lead foot half a pace toward the opponent while keeping the baton tucked in guard.

name: Planted Handlepeg
description: Press the long arm tight to the forearm and take a kick or club squarely on the rail.

name: Wide Spinflip
description: Step in and drive the rail forward so the long arm presses hard against the chest.

name: Brisk Spinpeg
description: Swing the elbow back with the short end leading and rake the ribs of a foe at your side.

name: Barpause
description: Sweep the rail up and across the body to knock a downward blow off its line.

name: Handlewedge
description: Hook the long arm over an extended wrist and pull it down to spoil the attacker's balance.

name: Nimble Tonfashaft
description: Step one foot backward with the rail held across the chest to open a safe distance.

name: Sharp Tap
description: Grip the handle and bring the long arm down in a short arc onto a collarbone or forearm.

name: Wide Gripbar
description: Let the long arm swing out on the handle and strike with the flat in one level rotation at hip height.

name: Planted Shortshaft
description: After a swing let the long arm roll back to the forearm so it shelters the elbow and flank.

name: Snug Roundend
description: Cross rail and arm in front of the chest to brush an incoming stick aside.

name: Tonfastay
description: Press the rail flat across the opponent's chest and lean in so they cannot lift their arms.

name: Rap Bump
description: Tap the short end twice into the same joint in fast succession to numb the gripping hand.

name: Bardodge
description: Pivot on the front foot and stride aside while settling the baton back into guard.

name: Descending Knock
description: Roll the wrist so the long arm spins half a circle and cracks against the guarding hand.

name: Folded Rearend
description: Spin the long arm in repeated full circles beside the body to bat away quick jabs.

name: Rapdrop
description: Flip the long arm back along the forearm and punch with the fist leading the shortened baton.

name: Sidehandle Hit
description: Whip the short end out of the fist with the wrist to hit a small target such as the throat notch.

name: Raptrot
description: Spin the haft once across the body as cover while stepping diagonally out of a charge.

name: Stopping Rearend
description: Catch the collar with the hooked long arm and drag the opponent off their stance.

name: Sudden Tonfashaft
description: Drop the wrist and spin the long arm low so its end raps the opponent's shin.

name: Angled Spinpeg
description: Raise both elbows with the baton riding the forearm and hold the frame while taking a flurry.

name: Roundend Wedge
description: Set the handle post at a slant so the long arm meets a blow at an angle and slides it off.

name: Wide Knock
description: Flick the wrist so the long arm snaps out and raps the cheek or temple with a sharp tap.

name: Raised Sidehandle
description: Drop the handle post low beside the hip and tuck the elbow behind the rail to cover the flank.

name: Locking Spinflip
description: Lean on the post and press the long arm down on a forearm to pin it against the opponent's thigh.

name: Raphit
description: Plant both feet and thrust the short end into the breastbone with the whole bodyweight behind the fist.

name: Rap Hop
description: Glide sideways with the post held close so the guard never opens during the move.

name: Raised Shortshaft
description: Breathe out and send a thread of qi along the rail to stiffen it against a hard cut.

name: Firm Forearm
description: Time a small qi pulse into the long arm as it jabs the notch just under the ribs.

name: Settled Handlepeg
description: Sweep the rail across on an outward breath and let a faint qi push turn the blow aside.

name: Flat Forearmside
description: Rap the short end onto a nerve point with a flick of qi that stings the whole hand.

name: Shifting Tap
description: Draw a breath and let qi lighten the lead foot so one quick step closes the gap.

name: Ready Tonfashaft
description: Hold the qi-stiffened long arm along the forearm and let blows break against it.

name: Narrow Rearend
description: Slip a swing off the forearm and answer at once with a qi-tipped jab from the short end.

name: Kept Sidehandle
description: Roll the long arm from the forward grip back to the forearm on a pulse of qi to turn a cut.

name: Handlelid
description: Anchor the elbow against the ribs and check the opponent's arm with the stiffened rail.

name: Straight Elbowside
description: Swing the long arm over the wrist in a quick hammer with qi gathered only at the tip.

name: Sideways Rap
description: Shuffle back two small steps behind the guard arm while qi keeps the legs light.

name: Folded Gripbar
description: Press the rail against your own ribs and brace it with qi to survive a tackle.

name: Downward Jolt
description: Turn the handle a quarter in the palm so the long arm cracks sideways with a pulse of qi.

name: Snug Gripbar
description: Turn the handle half around in the palm so the long arm latches a thrust and flips it away.

name: Rappause
description: Slowly turn the handle against a trapped wrist with qi steadying the rail as it binds.

name: Upward Spinflip
description: Spin the handle a full turn in the palm and let the long arm rebound into the opponent's ribs.

name: Snug Spinpeg
description: Turn the handle inward so the long arm drops under the elbow as a quick cover.

name: Rapamble
description: Skip on the back foot as the handle turns and let qi carry the body half a pace aside.

name: Gnawing Roundend
description: Close in until chest meets chest and press the rail up under the chin with a qi surge.

name: Catching Tap
description: Tap down on the opponent's weapon arm just above the wrist to drive the blade toward the ground.

name: Handlecowl
description: Step inside the swing arc and meet the weapon arm with the rail before the blade can turn.

name: Elbowside Drop
description: Drop the long arm and hit the side of the knee with a qi-sharpened short stroke.

name: Barhusk
description: Hook the long arm into the bend of the elbow and pull it across to open the opponent's side.

name: Light Knock
description: Step along the line of the opponent's hip with a small qi push so they cannot swing freely.

name: Joltblow
description: Throw two quick short jabs at cheek height with the stub and let a qi flicker harden each.

name: Handlehusk
description: Lay the rail over a rising rod or blade and press it down before it reaches your face.

name: Tapdrop
description: Whirl the long arm in an arc and let a ribbon of qi ride its spin into the target.

name: Tight Shortshaft
description: Keep the long arm turning in front of the torso with steady qi so each blow meets a moving rail.

name: Handledrop
description: Spin the long arm backward past the elbow and smash a foe who crowds from behind.

name: Solid Shortshaft
description: Spiral the rail outward through a thrust so the spinning arm carries it past your side.

name: Tonfapause
description: Circle low and hook the ankle with the long arm to throw the opponent's stride off.

name: Shifting Forearmside
description: Walk a small circle around the opponent behind the spinning baton with qi easing every foot fall.

name: Tonfahit
description: Stop the spin dead against the forearm and drive the stopped baton forward with a burst of qi.
